config.scope: tenant membership and document active state; vector-only retrieval; serial warm local HTTP

vectorizer: TF-IDF unigram/bigram + rank-128 truncated SVD + L2 normalization; not neural embeddings
ground_truth: Separate in-memory tenant assignment + active-state ledger; exact NumPy cosine reference; tie aware tolerance 1e-5
revocation: Per query choose its initially authorized highest cosine-scored document; revoke the union. Stale phase intentionally does not update indexes. Applied phase updates both shared and tenant copies and waits for acknowledgements. No concurrent queries.
